home.heroTagline: Connect with trusted local service professionals
home.benefitsSubtitle: A platform built on fairness, dignity, and real-time reliability.
home.benefit1Desc: Workers set their own hourly rates and price proposals. No extortionate middleman brokerage or commission cuts.
home.benefit2Desc: Instant notifications when jobs open in your local radius. Direct chat and scheduling with homeowners.
home.benefit3Desc: NID-backed digital profiles with verified reviews that help skilled workers earn up to 3x more steady income.
home.benefit4Desc: Clear scope of work, photos of the repair area upfront, and guaranteed agreed prices before travel.
home.storiesSubtitle: Empowering Bangladesh's Skilled Trades with Digital Trust
home.footerTagline: Karigor is Bangladesh's premier artisan-first local service marketplace. Connecting homeowners with verified technicians, plumbers, painters, and electricians with dignity and fair trade standards.
home.copyright: All rights reserved. Dedicated to the dignity of skilled labor in Bangladesh.
